predictions.text: I predict that pro-Palestine protesters will confront pro-Israel counterprotesters in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States, and at least three people will be arrested.
I predict that the Khor Mor gas field in Iraqi Kurdistan will face another drone attack, possibly targeting another storage facility, by the end of Tuesday, 17 November 2026.

I predict that a prominent individual in Paraguay will be found guilty of the alleged conflicts of interest involving a major financial institution, and the trial concludes with a verdict by the end of Tuesday, 17 November 2026, with Paraguay being the country involved.
I predict that Saudi airstrikes will hit homes near Sanaa, Yemen, resulting in at least 27 casualties.
I predict that another shootout will occur in Sinaloa, involving Mexican authorities and members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel.
I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least one more incident involving a ship being hit or an explosion occurring, likely near Qeshm Island.
I predict that the court hearing for the shooter will be scheduled for the city of Kraków, Poland, by the end of Tuesday, 17 November 2026.

I predict that prominent actors and a prominent organization will question the safety standards of facilities operated by local groups, particularly those in industrial zones near a major city, leading to the formation of a joint inquiry team involving representatives from both entities.
I predict that a prominent government agency and a major regulatory body in Egypt will present their findings on the cause of the incident at the public hearing scheduled for this week.
I predict that the investigation team will identify mechanical failure as the cause of the helicopter crash in South Kalimantan.
